title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Programme Note — Advance Late Fee Relief
content:
Holders of the Pocketwire Visa Debit Card who use their physical card regularly have their Pocketwire Advance payroll-delay relief worked out as follows. When the customer holds an active physical Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit, Signature Debit, Infinite Debit or Infinite Metal Debit card and made at least 10 card purchases in the three months before the handling date, the late fee multiplied by the relief share is multiplied by 1.4 before the relief is rounded to the cent (half up). When the customer holds an active physical Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit or Gold Debit card and made at least 10 card purchases in that window, 0.02 USD is added to the late fee multiplied by the relief share for each card purchase in that window, before the relief is rounded to the cent (half up). Otherwise the late fee multiplied by the relief share is rounded to the cent (half up) as it stands.

**The window.** A window of three months before the handling date covers the records dated after the same day of the month three months before the handling date, up to and including the handling date.

**What is read.** The tier, status and form of the customer's Pocketwire Visa Debit Card — the card must be active and physical — and the number of card purchase entries on the card ledger dated in the window.

## Treatment by card

| Active physical card | Card purchases in the window | Treatment before rounding |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum, Signature, Infinite or Infinite Metal Debit | 10 or more | Multiplied by 1.4 |
| Pocketwire Visa Classic or Gold Debit | 10 or more | 0.02 added for each card purchase in the window |
| Any tier | Fewer than 10 | None — rounded as it stands |
| No active physical card | Any number | None — rounded as it stands |

## Worked figures (hypothetical: late fee 2.00, relief share 0.30, so an unrounded figure of 0.60)

| Card | Purchases | Figure before rounding | Rounded (half up) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active physical Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | 12 | 0.60 multiplied by 1.4 gives 0.84 | 0.84 |
| Active physical Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit | 15 | 0.60 and 15 times 0.02, a total of 0.90 | 0.90 |
| Active physical Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 9 | 0.60 | 0.60 |
| Virtual Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit card only | 20 | 0.60 | 0.60 |
